contract: docs/design/workstation-contract.md (design contract, content states, target viewports 390x844, 768x1024, 1440x900; also swept at 360, 705 and 1024). Surfaces covered by this record: Board 'Check your design', Matter 'Simulate', Library with stored evidence entries, Templates, /try, the shell's hosted-tool states and the Agent panel (not connected and connected). The earlier record for the replay-based Board and Matter canvases is in git history (commit 7865628).

accessibility.evidence: Measured only on the Silicon workstation view with scripts/ws-a11y.mjs (a11y.json, taken earlier in the project): 26 consecutive Tab presses landed on visible elements with a solid focus outline in a sensible order, and computed text contrast over 34-35 elements per state had a minimum of 5.43:1 dark and 5.25:1 light with no failures. The new panels reuse the same tokens, form controls have visible labels or aria-labels, matrix and rung actions are real buttons, errors use role=alert and results use aria-live, but keyboard order, focus visibility and contrast were NOT re-measured on the Board, Matter, Library, Templates or Try surfaces, the plate canvas is operable only with its Rotate buttons and pointer drag, and the temperature ramp is backed by a numeric legend rather than tested for colour-vision accessibility. Reduced motion, screen readers and forced colours were not exercised.

responsive.evidence: scripts/ws-gate.mjs (overflow-hosted.json, overflow-connected-partial.json): documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth in every capture at 360x780, 390x844, 705x900, 768x1024, 1024x768 and 1440x900 for the Board check (empty, result, fault, fact, 400, 429, recorded-run empty), Matter simulate (empty, result, radial generator, local range error, recorded-run empty), the evidence drawer and tabs, Library with a stored entry open, Templates, /try, the home page and the Agent panel with and without a key. Two-column panels use container queries and minmax(0,1fr) tracks; the plate canvas and matrix scroll inside their own regions. The sweep found and fixed: panels staying single-column at 880 px, a header button wrapping on /try at phone width, an empty 'Rung B4 on' heading for live results, and shell chrome (run status, cost, Intent) still describing a Silicon replay while a hosted tool was open. Long content was checked only with real template titles, part fact ids and manifest text.

loading.evidence: The Board panel shows five stable placeholder rungs while a check runs and 'Loading templates…' while the list loads; the Matter panel shows a 'Solving…' state with the button disabled; the Library shows skeleton rows while manifests load. These transient states last well under a second locally and were NOT captured in a screenshot; they are verified by reading the rendered DOM states in code review only, so treat the loading evidence as weak. The recorded Silicon replay loading state was captured earlier (commit 7865628).

empty.evidence: ws-1440x900-board-empty-hosted.png (template loaded, 'No result yet' copy), ws-1440x900-matter-empty-hosted.png ('No simulation yet'), ws-1440x900-board-run-empty-hosted.png and ws-1440x900-matter-run-empty-hosted.png ('No recorded run is installed'), ws-1440x900-templates-hosted.png ('No templates yet'), ws-390x844-agent-hosted.png (not connected: 'Agent endpoint not connected yet', composer disabled) and ws-390x844-agent-starters-connected.png (connected, three starter prompts).

error.evidence: ws-1440x900-board-422-hosted.png: invalid JSON gives HTTP 400 with the engine's line and column message (Board returns 400 bad_json; the Matter equivalent is 422). ws-1440x900-board-429-hosted.png: rate limit state with the in-memory-per-instance explanation and a countdown. ws-1440x900-matter-local-error-hosted.png: an out-of-range Matter field is caught locally with the documented range under the field. ws-1440x900-board-fault-hosted.png: a real failing rung (B4, firmware GPIO12 vs netlist GPIO14) with no claim label and its fact ids. NOT rendered in a browser: a server 422 with field paths for Matter (local range checks stop those requests first; the API behaviour is covered by the end-to-end script and unit tests), 413, the network-down state, and agent upstream errors.

partial.evidence: ws-1440x900-board-fault-hosted.png: 4 of 5 rungs pass, with unknown or failing rungs explicitly not counted; ws-1440x900-matter-sim-hosted.png: 4 of 5 rungs pass (M5 does not beat the baseline) with the verdict, both baselines and the 'small margins' note instead of a win. The edited-after-check (stale) banner was not captured.

success.evidence: ws-1440x900-board-check-hosted.png (clean template, all five rungs pass, author-curated notice), ws-1440x900-matter-sim-hosted.png and ws-390x844-matter-sim-radial-hosted.png (plate coloured by the solver's temperatures with a numeric legend, rungs, baselines, an evidence drawer opened from the peak-temperature tag), ws-1440x900-library-stored-open-hosted.png (stored entry with its reproduce command, claims, not-claimed list, tool versions and artifact hashes), ws-1440x900-agent-answer-connected.png (a real Nemotron answer that called board_check and cited evidence ids; this one needs a key on the served build).

permission.reason: The per-visitor and daily agent limits exist in /api/agent (HTTP 429 with a plain message) and are covered by unit tests, but the agent limit state was not rendered in a browser. The Board and Matter 429 state was rendered (see error). No other surface has an access boundary.

renderedEvidence.observation: Board 'Check your design': template picker with the three real templates, editable design JSON, result with five rungs, per-rung detail and fact-id chips, honest-limits notice, shell status 'Hosted tool · no model' and cost $0.00.

Faulty template checked: 4 of 5 rungs pass, B4 selected and its evidence drawer shows Fail, the detail (wake_btn firmware says GPIO12, netlist wires GPIO14), no claim, source 'Hosted Board check, this call', and the cited fact ids with the author-curated note.
Board check at phone width: single column, template picker, editor, then result.
Rate-limited check: amber 'Too many requests' with HTTP 429 and the per-instance explanation.
Malformed design JSON: 'The input was not accepted', HTTP 400, line 1 column 11.

Matter 'Simulate': generator and parameter controls with their ranges, the extruded plate coloured by temperature with a numeric scale from the coolest material cell to the peak, 4 of 5 rungs pass in 30 ms.

Radial-spoke simulation with the peak-temperature evidence tag opened: the Evidence tab shows rung M4, Pass, the second-solver claim, source 'Hosted Matter simulation, this call', and the FV and FEM numbers.
Spine width 99 is refused locally with the documented 6-12 range under the field.
Library: stored entry dot4 open with the reproduce command and Copy, the statement that the page does not run it, claims, not claimed, system numbers, source run, tools and versions, artifact hashes.
The same entry at phone width.
Library list at tablet width with stored entries and recorded-run instructions.
Templates with no manifest installed: the honest empty state.
/try: four 'Try it' paths (Check a board, Simulate a heat spreader, Reproduce a library entry, Watch a recorded run); the header button reads Workstation and no longer wraps.
Home page with 'Open the workstation' as the primary call to action.
The workstation default (Silicon replay) is unchanged; Agent not connected.
Agent panel with a key on the server: starter prompts, read-only note and limits copy that says counting is per server instance.
A real answer: tool-call card for board_check (read-only, done), the answer naming B4 and the cited evidence ids.
